Form No. 2
G. 2000-8-29

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Sintza Police Station,
No. L. O. D. 607
Date October 26th, 19 29
Extra....................

Subject (in full) Indecent Advertisement.

Made/by and Forwarded by Inspector Dunne.

Sir,

I beg to report that I interviewed Mr. Crispesen at the
Apollo Theatre re attached figure, and was informed by him that
a Madam Reviere who is a member of the Samonan Troupe now appear-
ing at the Embassy Theatre asked the management to have a contour
of her figure with the necessary habiliment shown in the local
papers as an advertisement. An order was given to a Chinese artist
but he did not draw the figure as instructed.

The breasts are shown covered by brassieres and the lower
part of the body by a girdle.

The management of the Embassy on seeing the figure in the
papers notified the editors to have it withdrawn, this was
complied with.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

P. Dunne.
Inspector.

A. C. (South)

a oct
I think he will settle
the matter.
26.10.29
llp
Rem.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

档案编号
上海公共租界工部局
静安寺捕房，
L. O. D. 607号
日期：1929年10月26日
附件....................

事由（详述）：不雅广告。

由邓恩（Dunne）巡官呈报并转送。

先生：

谨此报告，本人就所附图像一事，在阿波罗剧院（Apollo Theatre）采访了克里斯皮森（Crispesen）先生。据他告知，目前在爱多亚路剧院（Embassy Theatre）演出的萨摩亚剧团（Samonan Troupe）成员雷维尔夫人（Madam Reviere），要求管理层在当地报纸上刊登一则广告，展示其身着必要服饰的身体轮廓图。该任务已委托给一位中国画家，但他并未按照指示绘制该图像。

图中乳房部分显示由胸罩遮盖，身体下部则由束腰带遮盖。

爱多亚路剧院管理层在看到报纸上的图像后，通知编辑予以撤下，该要求已得到遵照执行。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，

P. 邓恩（P. Dunne）
巡官

A. C. (南区)

a oct
我想他会解决
此事。
1929年10月26日
